summary: Straight-line initializer for two adjacent 4-byte globals at 0x007CA3E0: writes the dword dword_7CA3E0 to -1082130432, the raw integer spelling for the float -1.0, and sets the float flt_7CA3E4 to 0.0. Likely seeds a (minus-one, zero) pair used as a float-range default.

Write 0.0 to the adjacent float global flt_7CA3E4.
